title: Gauged: Multiple CAMELS Forcings
subtitle: 531 basins, Newman evaluation decade (1989–1999) — Two or three CAMELS forcings (Daymet, Maurer, NLDAS).

rows.paradigm: Regional Single- & Multi-Forcing Long Short-Term Memory Network
rows.family_description: Author-archived 10-seed single-forcing (Daymet, Maurer, NLDAS) and multi-forcing (Daymet+Maurer+NLDAS, Daymet+Maurer, Daymet+NLDAS, Maurer+NLDAS) 256-unit CudaLSTM models with 365-day lookback window and 27 static CAMELS attributes, trained with NSE* loss over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Kratzert et al., 2021; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.4670268).
rows.notes: 10-seed ensemble mean of the Kratzert et al. (2021) 365-day lookback regional CudaLSTM trained jointly with Daymet + Maurer + NLDAS meteorological forcings (15 dynamic inputs + 27 static catchment attributes) across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.4670268; 531-basin Ensemble Med NSE = 0.821, Mean NSE = 0.768, Med KGE = 0.801; 447-basin subset Ensemble Med NSE = 0.818).

rows.paradigm: Multi-Structure Hybrid Ensemble (Regional LSTM + Differentiable HBV 1.1p)
rows.family_description: Multi-structure hybrid ensemble of Li, Song, Pan, Lawson, and Shen (2025, HESS 29, 6829-6861; DOI: 10.5194/hess-29-6829-2025; Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.16895228) combining multi-forcing regional LSTM predictions with differentiable HBV 1.1p (dMG) predictions. On Stage-1 Split-3 (WY1980-1995 train / WY1995-2008 test, 531 basins), the 60-member multi-forcing hybrid ensemble (LSTM + dHBV)_seed^123 achieves Med NSE = 0.8225 (published 0.823; independent StandaloneDHBV Split-3 re-run hybrid = 0.8195), the single-seed 6-member multi-forcing hybrid (LSTM + dHBV)^123 achieves Med NSE = 0.8176 +/- 0.0040 (member[0] = 0.8184 vs published 0.818; re-run = 0.8165), and the Daymet single-seed hybrid (LSTM + dHBV)^1_Daymet achieves Med NSE = 0.7895 (member[0]; 10-seed mean 0.7871 +/- 0.0013 vs published 0.790; re-run = 0.7872). On Stage-2 Newman Split-1 (WY1999-2008 train / WY1989-1999 test, 531 basins, Daymet + Maurer + NLDAS), the equal-weight 2-component multi-structure ensemble (t4_06.zarr; member[0] = Kratzert et al. 2021 10-seed 3-forcing LSTM ensemble t4_05.zarr with Med NSE = 0.8210, member[1] = Song et al. 2024 5-seed 3-forcing dHBV 1.1p ensemble t4_24.zarr with Med NSE = 0.7992) achieves Med NSE = 0.8200 (0.820), matching the 20-member equal-seed ensemble t4_03.zarr (Med NSE = 0.8195 / 0.820). No separate single-model row is emitted for li2025_lstm_dhbv_ens because its individual constituent models (kratzert2021_lstm_archive and song_dhbv11p) are already evaluated as standalone entries on Table 4.
rows.notes: Equal-weight 2-component multi-structure hybrid ensemble combining member[0] = Kratzert et al. (2021) 10-seed 3-forcing Regional LSTM Author Archive ensemble (t4_05.zarr, Med NSE = 0.821) and member[1] = our 5-seed 3-forcing Song et al. (2024) dHBV 1.1p MIP Re-run ensemble (t4_24.zarr, Med NSE = 0.799). Single-model Med NSE is omitted (---) because the two members of t4_06.zarr are themselves multi-seed ensembles from two distinct model architectures and provenances (Author Archive + Our Code) that are evaluated separately in Table 4.

rows.family_name: TSLib Deep Learning Suite (10 Models: Crossformer, PatchTST, Informer, etc.)
rows.family_description: Ten general-purpose time-series deep learning models adapted from the Time-Series-Library (TSLib) via the rainflow hydrology benchmark framework (9 Transformer variants: Crossformer, Non-stationary Transformer, Vanilla Transformer, Informer, Pyraformer, ETSformer, Reformer, iTransformer, and CARDformer; plus the moving-average linear decomposition model DLinear), trained simultaneously on Daymet, Maurer, and NLDAS forcings and 26 static catchment attributes across all 531 CAMELS-US basins over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 (Liu et al., 2025, Supplement Table S1; PatchTST and TimesNet were evaluated in the same study on autoregressive forecasting tasks).
rows.notes: Published single-seed (seed=42) CAMELS regression benchmark from Liu et al. (2025, HESS 29, 6811–6828, Supplement Table S1, p. 5; original architecture by Zhang & Yan, 2023 ICLR). Trained on WY2000–2008 and evaluated on WY1990–1999 (364 warmup days) across all 531 Newman basins using 15 dynamic channels (Daymet + Maurer + NLDAS) and 26 static attributes (seq_len=365, seg_len=24, d_model=64, d_ff=128, n_heads=4, e_layers=2, d_layers=1, lr=0.001, 30 epochs, global z-score MSE loss). Note: FLV in Liu et al. (2025) is computed as linear low-flow percent bias on the bottom 30% of flows rather than log-space FDC volume bias.

rows.paradigm: Conceptual Soil Moisture Accounting + Snow-17 Model (DDS & 29-D Donor Transfer)
rows.family_description: Clean-room C++17/OpenMP and Python re-implementation of coupled Snow-17 + SAC-SMA + 15-day Duamel Gamma unit hydrograph (27 calibrated parameters) calibrated per basin using Dynamically Dimensioned Search (DDS; Tolson & Shoemaker, 2007) over WY2000–2008 (Nearing et al., 2020), and extended to ungauged 12-fold PUB and 18-fold HUC-02 PUR prediction via k=1 nearest-neighbor donor parameter transfer in a 29-dimensional joint geographic and standardized static catchment-attribute space.
rows.notes: Clean-room 27-parameter Snow-17 + SAC-SMA + 15-day Duamel Gamma unit hydrograph calibrated per basin via DDS (400 iterations, r=0.2, 365-day spinup, daily RMSE objective) across all 3 CAMELS forcing products (Daymet, Maurer, NLDAS) and 3 seeds (seeds 101, 102, 103) over 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 and evaluated over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 on all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Ensemble Mean Median NSE = 0.695).

rows.paradigm: Conceptual Soil Moisture Accounting + Snow-17 Model (DDS & 29-D Donor Transfer)

protocol.benchmark_name: CAMELS-531 Unified Model Intercomparison Project (Newman Period)
protocol.train_period: 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 (9 water years, water years 2000–2008; 3,288 daily steps)
protocol.eval_period: 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 (10 water years, water years 1990–1999; 3652 daily steps)

spatial_regimes.title: Gauged Simulation
spatial_regimes.description: Temporal split-sample across all 531 CAMELS-US benchmark basins: calibrated/trained on water years 2000–2008 (1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30) and evaluated out-of-sample on water years 1990–1999 (1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30).

spatial_regimes.title: Prediction in Ungauged Basins (12-Fold Random PUB)
spatial_regimes.description: Out-of-sample spatial cross-validation across k = 12 random folds of the 531 basins (44–45 basins/fold), trained on 11 folds during water years 2000–2008 and evaluated on the held-out fold during water years 1990–1999.

spatial_regimes.title: Prediction in Ungauged Regions (18-Fold HUC-02 PUR)
spatial_regimes.description: Zero-shot regional extrapolation across all 18 USGS two-digit HUC-02 hydrologic regions: trained on 17 regions during water years 2000–2008 and evaluated on the held-out HUC-02 region during water years 1990–1999.

forcing_regimes.title: Single CAMELS Forcing
forcing_regimes.description: Models driven by a single standard CAMELS-US meteorological dataset (Daymet, Maurer, or NLDAS) without lagged streamflow inputs.

forcing_regimes.title: Multiple CAMELS Forcings
forcing_regimes.description: Models driven simultaneously by any combination of two or three standard CAMELS-US meteorological datasets (Daymet, Maurer, and/or NLDAS) without lagged streamflow inputs.

forcing_regimes.title: With Lagged Streamflow Inputs
forcing_regimes.description: Models ingesting lagged observed streamflow, autoregression, or data assimilation alongside meteorological forcings (or donor-gauge transfer in PUB/PUR).

forcing_regimes.title: Freeform Forcings (Non-CAMELS Inputs)
forcing_regimes.description: Models driven by non-CAMELS meteorological forcing products (such as AORC, EM-Earth, or ERA5-Land).

provenance_categories.Literature: Skill scores extracted directly from a published paper evaluated on the standard splits.
provenance_categories.Archive: Metrics calculated by the MIP from publicly archived daily hydrographs associated with a prior published paper.
provenance_categories.Archive*: Metrics calculated by the MIP from publicly archived daily hydrographs on a partial basin subset (<531 basins) or non-standard time period.
provenance_categories.MIP Re-run: Published model re-implemented and re-run by the MIP on the standardized 531-basin splits.
provenance_categories.Contribution: New model contributed directly to the MIP benchmark.
